586.name: Fade
586.description: Fade out, removing all your threat and reducing enemies' detection range against you for 10 sec.

642.name: Divine Shield
642.description: Grants immunity to all damage, harmful effects, knockbacks and forced movement effects for 8 sec. Cannot be used if you have Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.

1122.name: Summon Infernal
1122.description: Summons an Infernal from the Twisting Nether, impacting for 231 Fire damage and stunning all enemies in the area for 2 sec. The Infernal will serve you for 30 sec, dealing 221 damage to all nearby enemies every 1.8 sec and generating 1 Soul Shard Fragment every 1 sec.

1719.name: Recklessness
1719.description: Go berserk, increasing all Rage generation by 50% and granting your abilities 20% increased critical strike chance for 12 sec.

1856.name: Vanish
1856.description: Allows you to vanish from sight, entering stealth while in combat. For the first 3 sec after vanishing, damage and harmful effects received will not break stealth. Also breaks movement impairing effects.

1966.name: Feint
1966.description: Performs an evasive maneuver, reducing damage taken from area-of-effect attacks by 40% for 6 sec.

5217.name: Tiger's Fury
5217.description: Instantly restores 50 Energy, and increases the damage of all your attacks by 15% for their full duration. Lasts 10 sec.

5277.name: Evasion
5277.description: Increases your dodge chance by 100% for 10 sec.

5487.name: Bear Form
5487.description: Shapeshift into Bear Form, increasing armor by 220% and Stamina by 25%, granting protection from Polymorph effects, and increasing threat generation. The act of shapeshifting frees you from movement impairing effects.

5938.name: Shiv
5938.description: Attack with your off-hand, dealing 2 Physical damage, dispelling all enrage effects and applying a concentrated form of your active Non-Lethal poison. Awards 1 combo point.

6201.name: Create Healthstone
6201.description: Creates a Healthstone that can be consumed to restore 25% health.

11426.name: Ice Barrier
11426.description: Shields you with ice, absorbing 9,165 damage for 1 min. Melee attacks against you reduce the attacker's movement speed by 50%.

13750.name: Adrenaline Rush
13750.description: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 75%, your maximum Energy by 50, and your attack speed by 20% for 15 sec.

15286.name: Vampiric Embrace
15286.description: Fills you with the embrace of Shadow energy for 12 sec, causing you to heal a nearby ally for 40% of any single-target Shadow spell damage you deal.

19236.name: Desperate Prayer
19236.description: Increases maximum health by 25% for 10 sec, and instantly heals you for that amount.

19574.name: Bestial Wrath
19574.description: Sends you and your pet into a rage, instantly dealing 280 Physical damage to its target, and increasing all damage you both deal by 20% for 15 sec. Removes all crowd control effects from your pet.

22812.name: Barkskin
22812.description: Your skin becomes as tough as bark, reducing all damage you take by 20% and preventing damage from delaying your spellcasts. Lasts 8 sec. Usable while stunned, frozen, incapacitated, feared, or asleep, and in all shapeshift forms.

23920.name: Spell Reflection
23920.description: Raise your weapon, reflecting the first spell cast on you and reducing magic damage you take by 20% for 5 sec.

31224.name: Cloak of Shadows
31224.description: Provides a moment of magic immunity, instantly removing all harmful spell effects. The cloak lingers, causing you to resist harmful spells for 5 sec.

31884.name: Avenging Wrath
31884.description: Call upon the Light to become an avatar of retribution, increasing your damage, healing, and critical strike chance by 20% for 20 sec.

32375.name: Mass Dispel
32375.description: Dispels magic in a 15 yard radius, removing all harmful Magic from 5 friendly targets and 1 beneficial Magic effect from 5 enemy targets. Potent enough to remove Magic that is normally undispellable.

42650.name: Army of the Dead
42650.description: Summon or empower Lesser Ghouls to form an unholy army of 8 for 30 sec. While active, summoning a Lesser Ghoul will instead execute Orders based on nearby enemies. Death Orders Lesser Ghouls strike with you, dealing 11 Shadow damage to your target. Epidemic Orders Lesser Ghouls erupt in viscera, dealing 2 Shadow damage to nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

46585.name: Raise Dead
46585.description: Raises a ghoul to fight by your side. You can have a maximum of one ghoul at a time. Lasts 1 min.

48265.name: Death's Advance
48265.description: For 10 sec, your movement speed is increased by 35%, you cannot be slowed below 100% of normal speed, and you are immune to forced movement effects and knockbacks. Passive: You cannot be slowed below 70% of normal speed.

48707.name: Anti-Magic Shell
48707.description: Surrounds you in an Anti-Magic Shell for 5 sec, absorbing up to 9,165 magic damage and preventing application of harmful magical effects. Damage absorbed generates Runic Power.

48792.name: Icebound Fortitude
48792.description: Your blood freezes, granting immunity to Stun effects and reducing all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec.

49039.name: Lichborne
49039.description: Draw upon unholy energy to become Undead for 10 sec, increasing Leech by 6% and making you immune to Charm, Fear, and Sleep.

51052.name: Anti-Magic Zone
51052.description: Places an Anti-Magic Zone for 6 sec, reducing the magic damage taken by party or raid members by 15%.

51271.name: Pillar of Frost
51271.description: The power of frost increases your Strength by 20% for 12 sec.

51690.name: Killing Spree
51690.description: Finishing move that unleashes a barrage of gunfire, striking random enemies within 8 yards for Physical damage. Number of strikes increased per combo point. Restores 1 combo point every 0.45 sec. Each combo point spent above 5 increases damage by 15%. 1 point : 314 over 0.45 sec 2 points: 471 over 0.89 sec 3 points: 627 over 1.34 sec 4 points: 784 over 1.78 sec 5 points: 941 over 2.23 sec

55342.name: Mirror Image
55342.description: Creates 3 copies of you nearby for 15 sec, which cast spells and attack your enemies. While active, you generate significantly reduced threat. Taking direct damage will cause one of your images to dissipate.

61336.name: Survival Instincts
61336.description: Reduces all damage you take by 50% for 6 sec.

80240.name: Havoc
80240.description: Marks a target with Havoc for 15 sec, causing your single target spells to also strike the Havoc victim for 50% of the damage dealt.

84714.name: Frozen Orb
84714.description: Launches an orb of swirling ice in front of you, dealing up to 5,637 Frost damage to all enemies it passes through over 15 sec. After a short delay, Frozen Orb will pursue its target. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets. Enemies damaged by the Frozen Orb are slowed by 50% for 8 sec.

97462.name: Rallying Cry
97462.description: Lets loose a rallying cry, granting all party or raid members within 40 yards 10% temporary and maximum health for 10 sec. Health granted increased by 50% when not in a raid.

104773.name: Unending Resolve
104773.description: Hardens your skin, reducing all damage you take by 25% and granting immunity to interrupt, silence, and pushback effects for 8 sec.

106951.name: Berserk
106951.description: Go Berserk for 15 sec. While Berserk: Generate 1 combo point every 1.5 sec. Combo point generating abilities generate 1 additional combo point. Finishing moves restore up to 3 combo points generated over the cap. All attack and ability damage is increased by 15%.

107574.name: Avatar
107574.description: Transform into a colossus, increasing all damage you deal by 20% and reducing damage you take from area of effect attacks by 5% for 20 sec.

108271.name: Astral Shift
108271.description: Shift partially into the elemental planes, taking 40% less damage for 12 sec.

108416.name: Dark Pact
108416.description: Sacrifices 20% of your current health to shield you for 200% of the sacrificed health plus an additional 950 for 20 sec. Usable while suffering from control impairing effects.

109304.name: Exhilaration
109304.description: Heals you for 30% and your pet for 100% of maximum health.

114050.name: Ascendance
114050.description: Transform into a Flame Ascendant for 15 sec, instantly casting a Flame Shock and a 50% effectiveness Lava Burst at up to 6 nearby enemies. While ascended, Elemental Overload damage is increased by 30% and spells affected by your Mastery: Elemental Overload cause 1 additional Elemental Overload.

114051.name: Ascendance
114051.description: Transform into an Air Ascendant for 15 sec and unleash Doom Winds, reducing the cooldown and cost of Stormstrike by 60%, and transforming your auto attack and Stormstrike into Wind attacks which bypass armor and have a 30 yd range. Maelstrom Weapon spenders have a 0.5% chance to unleash Doom Winds per Maelstrom Weapon spent while Ascendance is not active.

115203.name: Fortifying Brew
115203.description: Turns your skin to stone for 15 sec.

118038.name: Die by the Sword
118038.description: Increases your parry chance by 100% and reduces all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec.

120644.name: Halo
120644.description: Creates a ring of Shadow energy around you that quickly expands to a 40 yd radius, healing allies for 604 and dealing 544 Shadow damage to enemies. Healing reduced beyond 6 targets.

121471.name: Shadow Blades
121471.description: Draws upon surrounding shadows to empower your weapons, causing your attacks to deal 20% additional damage as Shadow and causing your combo point generating abilities to generate double combo points for 16 sec.

122470.name: Touch of Karma
122470.description: Absorbs all damage taken for 10 sec, up to 50% of your maximum health, and redirects 70% of that amount to the enemy target as Nature damage over 6 sec.

153561.name: Meteor
153561.description: Calls down a meteor which lands at the target location after 3 sec, dealing 3,800 Fire damage to all enemies, and burns the ground, dealing 1,754 Fire damage over 4 sec to all enemies in the area. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

167105.name: Colossus Smash
167105.description: Smash the ground and shatter the armor of all enemies within 10 yds, dealing 108 Physical damage and increasing damage you deal to them by 30% for 10 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

184364.name: Enraged Regeneration
184364.description: Reduces damage taken by 30% and Bloodthirst restores an additional 20% health for 8 sec. Usable while stunned or incapacitated.

185311.name: Crimson Vial
185311.description: Drink an alchemical concoction that heals you for 20% of your maximum health over 4 sec.

185313.name: Shadow Dance
185313.description: Allows the use of Stealth abilities, grants the combat benefits of Stealth, and drastically reduces threat for 6 sec. Effect not broken from taking damage or attacking.

186257.name: Aspect of the Cheetah
186257.description: Increases your movement speed by 90% for 3 sec. Upon expiring, increases your movement speed by 30% for another 9 sec.

186289.name: Aspect of the Eagle
186289.description: Increases the range of your Raptor Strike and Mastery: Spirit Bond to 40 yds for 15 sec.

190319.name: Combustion
190319.description: Engulfs you in flames for 10 sec, increasing your spells' critical strike chance by 100%. Castable while casting other spells.

191634.name: Stormkeeper
191634.description: Charge yourself with lightning, causing your next 2 Lightning Bolts to be instant cast and deal 150% more damage, or cause your next 2 Chain Lightings to be instant cast and trigger an Elemental Overload on every target.

192077.name: Wind Rush Totem
192077.description: Summons a totem at the target location for 15 sec, continually granting all allies who pass within 10 yards 40% increased movement speed for 5 sec.

196718.name: Darkness
196718.description: Summons darkness around you in an 8 yd radius, granting friendly targets a 15% chance to avoid all damage from an attack. Lasts 8 sec. Chance to avoid damage increased by 100% when not in a raid.

198013.name: Eye Beam
198013.description: Blasts all enemies in front of you, for up to 286 Chaos damage over 1.8 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

198103.name: Earth Elemental
198103.description: Calls forth a Greater Earth Elemental to protect you and your allies, generating high threat and taunting enemies periodically for 30 sec.

198589.name: Blur
198589.description: Reduces all damage taken by 25% for 10 sec.

198793.name: Vengeful Retreat
198793.description: Remove all snares and vault away. Nearby enemies take 5 Physical damage.

202770.name: Fury of Elune
202770.description: Calls down a beam of pure celestial energy that follows the enemy, dealing up to 1,134 Astral damage over 8 sec within its area. Damage reduced on secondary targets. Generates 40 Astral Power over its duration.

205021.name: Ray of Frost
205021.description: Channel an icy beam at the enemy for 3.6 sec, dealing 1,898 Frost damage every 0.45 sec. Applies 8 stacks of Freezing over its duration.

205180.name: Summon Darkglare
205180.description: Summons a Darkglare from the Twisting Nether that increases the damage of your Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction by 20% while active. The Darkglare will serve you for 20 sec, blasting its target for 1,863 Shadow damage, increased by 10% for every damage over time effect you have active on their current target.

228260.name: Voidform
228260.description: Bombards your target with a Void Volley and twists your Shadowform with void magic, increasing your spell damage by 20% for 20 sec. During Voidform, Void Volley replaces this spell and can be used up to 3 times. Void Volley Releases a volley of pure void energy, firing 10 bolts at your target and 1 bolt at all enemies within 10 yards of your target for 362 Shadow damage. Generates 10 Insanity.

235313.name: Blazing Barrier
235313.description: Shields you in flame, absorbing 9,165 damage for 1 min. Melee attacks against you cause the attacker to take 60 Fire damage.

235450.name: Prismatic Barrier
235450.description: Shields you with an arcane force, absorbing 9,165 damage and reducing magic damage taken by 15% for 1 min. The duration of harmful Magic effects against you is reduced by 25%.

255937.name: Wake of Ashes
255937.description: Lash out at your enemies, dealing 113 Radiant damage to all enemies within 14 yds in front of you, and applying Truth's Wake, burning the targets for an additional 67 damage over 9 sec. Demon and Undead enemies are also stunned for 5 sec. Generates 3 Holy Power.

258860.name: Essence Break
258860.description: Slash all enemies in front of you for 163 Chaos damage, causing Chaos Strike and Blade Dance to deal 89 Chaos damage to them for 4 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

260243.name: Volley
260243.description: Rain a volley of arrows down over 6 sec, dealing up to 705 Physical damage to any enemy in the area, and gain the effects of Trick Shots for as long as Volley is active.

260708.name: Sweeping Strikes
260708.description: Your next 12 damaging single-target abilities hit 1 additional target within 8 yds for 75% damage. Lasts 30 sec.

264735.name: Survival of the Fittest
264735.description: Reduces all damage you and your pet take by 30% for 6 sec.

265187.name: Summon Demonic Tyrant
265187.description: Summon a Demonic Tyrant that damages your target for 15 sec. Damage dealt by Demonic Tyrant is increased by 10% for each Wild Imp and Dreadstalker active.

274837.name: Feral Frenzy
274837.description: Unleash a furious frenzy, clawing your target 5 times for 28 Physical damage and an additional 192 Bleed damage over 6 sec. Awards 5 combo points.

280719.name: Secret Technique
280719.description: Finishing move that creates shadow clones of yourself. You and your shadow clones each perform a piercing attack on all enemies near your target, dealing Physical damage to the primary target and reduced damage to other targets. 1 point : 29 total damage 2 points: 58 total damage 3 points: 87 total damage 4 points: 118 total damage 5 points: 149 total damage

288613.name: Trueshot
288613.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 10% and critical strike damage by 20% for 15 sec. Aimed Shot Cooldown recovers 40% faster. Rapid Fire Cooldown recovers 60% faster.

321507.name: Touch of the Magi
321507.description: Applies Touch of the Magi to your current target, accumulating 20% of the damage you deal to the target for 12 sec, and then exploding for that amount of Arcane damage to the target and reduced damage to all nearby enemies. Generates 4 Arcane Charges.

322109.name: Touch of Death
322109.description: You exploit the enemy target's weakest point, instantly dealing damage equal to 100% of your maximum health to them. Only usable on creatures that have less health than you.

343527.name: Execution Sentence
343527.description: Unleash a heavenly blast around the target, dealing 176 Holy damage to all enemies within 10 yds, and call down a hammer that slowly falls from the sky upon the target. After 10 sec, they suffer 20% of the Holy damage you dealt to all targets affected by the initial blast during that time.

360194.name: Deathmark
360194.description: Carve a deathmark into an enemy, dealing 125 Bleed damage and restoring 80 Energy to you over 16 sec. Damage dealt to the target by your Garrote, Rupture, and Lethal Poisons is increased by 75%. Each time you apply a Lethal Poison to the target, apply it twice.

363916.name: Obsidian Scales
363916.description: Reinforce your scales, reducing damage taken by 30% . Lasts 12 sec.

365350.name: Arcane Surge
365350.description: Expend all of your current mana to annihilate your enemy target and nearby enemies for up to 3,844 Arcane damage based on Mana spent. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets. For the next 15 sec, your Mana regeneration is increased by 425% and spell damage is increased by 35%. Generates Clearcasting.

370553.name: Tip the Scales
370553.description: Compress time to make your next empowered spell cast instantly at its maximum empower level.

374227.name: Zephyr
374227.description: Conjure an updraft to lift you and your 4 nearest allies within 20 yds into the air, reducing damage taken from area-of-effect attacks by 20% and increasing movement speed by 30% for 8 sec.

374968.name: Time Spiral
374968.description: Bend time, allowing you and your allies within 40 yds to cast their major movement ability once in the next 10 sec, even if it is on cooldown.

375087.name: Dragonrage
375087.description: Erupt with draconic fury and exhale Pyres at 3 enemies within 25 yds. For 18 sec, Essence Burst's chance to occur is increased to 100%.

375576.name: Divine Toll
375576.description: Instantly cast Holy Shock, Avenger's Shield, or Judgment on up to 5 targets within 30 yds.

381989.name: Keep It Rolling
381989.description: Increase the remaining duration of your active Roll the Bones combat enhancement by 30 sec.

385627.name: Kingsbane
385627.description: Release a powerful poison from your weapons and inject it into your target, dealing 51 Nature damage instantly and an additional 71 Nature damage over 14 sec. Each time you apply a Lethal Poison to a target affected by Kingsbane, Kingsbane damage increases by 20%, up to 1,000%. Awards 1 combo point.

391528.name: Convoke the Spirits
391528.description: Call upon the spirits for an eruption of energy, channeling a rapid flurry of 16 Druid spells and abilities over 4 sec. You will cast Wild Growth, Swiftmend, Moonfire, Wrath, Regrowth, Rejuvenation, Rake, and Thrash on appropriate nearby targets, favoring your current shapeshift form.

395152.name: Ebon Might
395152.description: Increase all damage dealing allies' primary stat by 8.0% of your own and increase your own damage by 20% for 10 sec. Ebon Might will split its effect when applied to more than 2 other allies. Eruption, Deep Breath, and your empower spells extend the duration of these effects.

403631.name: Breath of Eons
403631.description: Fly to the targeted location, exposing a Temporal Wound on enemies in your path for 10 sec. Removes roots and grants immunity to movement impairing and loss of control effects while flying. Temporal Wound 15% of damage dealt by allies affected by Ebon Might is copied as additional Arcane damage to enemies after 10 sec. Damage is reduced if Ebon Might affects more than 2 other allies.

403876.name: Divine Protection
403876.description: Reduces all damage you take by 20% for 8 sec. Usable while stunned.

404977.name: Time Skip
404977.description: Surge forward in time, causing your cooldowns to recover 1,000% faster for 2 sec.

406732.name: Spatial Paradox
406732.description: Evoke a paradox for you and a friendly healer, allowing casting while moving and increasing the range of most spells by 100% for 10 sec. Affects the nearest healer within 60 yds, if you do not have a healer targeted.

426591.name: Goremaw's Bite
426591.description: Lash out at your target and 2 additional nearby enemies, inflicting 216 Shadow damage and causing them to Bleed for 428 damage over 14 sec. 20% of all damage from Finishing Moves is repeated as Shadow, split evenly among affected enemies.

439843.name: Reaper's Mark
439843.description: Viciously slice into the soul of your enemy, dealing 81 Shadowfrost damage and applying Reaper's Mark. Each time you deal Shadow or Frost damage, add a stack of Reaper's Mark. After 12 sec or reaching 40 stacks, the mark explodes, dealing 10 damage per stack. Reaper's Mark travels to an unmarked enemy nearby if the target dies.

442726.name: Malevolence
442726.description: Dark magic erupts from you and corrupts your soul for 20 sec, causing enemies suffering from your Wither to take 4,808 Shadowflame damage and increase its stack count by 6. While corrupted your Haste is increased by 8% and spending Soul Shards on damaging spells grants 1 additional stack of Wither.

1233448.name: Dark Transformation
1233448.description: Corrupt and evolve your Ghoul into a Monstrosity, greatly empowering its abilities for 15 sec. Death Coil and Epidemic extends the duration of this effect by 1.0 sec.

1249625.name: Zenith
1249625.description: Chi costs are reduced by 1 and Blackout Kick reduces the cooldown of affected abilities by an additional 1 sec for 15 sec. Activating Zenith resets the remaining cooldown on Rising Sun Kick.

1249658.name: Breath of Sindragosa
1249658.description: Call upon Sindragosa's aid in battle for 8 sec, continuously dealing 39 Frost damage every 1 sec to enemies in a cone in front of you. Consuming Killing Machine or Rime increases the duration by 0.8 sec. Deals reduced damage to secondary targets. Grants a charge of Empower Rune Weapon at the start and 2 Runes at the end.

1257052.name: Dark Harvest
1257052.description: Consume the life force of each target afflicted by your damaging periodic effects, dealing 12,764 Shadowflame damage over 2.7 sec. Damage dealt by Dark Harvest heals you for 50% of damage done.

1261193.name: Boomstick
1261193.description: Unload a series of 4 shotgun blasts 20 yds in front of you, dealing 851 Physical damage over 2.7 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

1276452.name: Grimoire: Imp Lord
1276452.description: Summons an Imp Lord to assist you in combat for 20 sec and will remove 1 harmful effect from you when summoned. Transforms into Singe Magic while on cooldown.

-155947.name: Living Flame
-155947.description: Use: Increases Intellect by 15 for 20 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

-156000.name: Wrathstone
-156000.description: Use: Increases Agility or Strength by 15 for 20 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

-156021.name: Energy Siphon
-156021.description: Use: Increases Critical Strike by 28 for 20 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

-156187.name: Scale of Fates
-156187.description: Use: Increases Haste by 28 for 20 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

-193701.name: Algeth'ar Puzzle Box
-193701.description: Use: Solve a puzzle, increasing your Mastery by 112 for 20 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

-193762.name: Blazebinder's Hoof
-193762.description: Use: Bind with the blaze for 20 sec, giving your attacks a high chance to increase your Strength by 8, stacking up to 6 times. When your binding is complete, emit a burnout wave, dealing up to 2,395 Fire damage split between all nearby enemies, based on the strength of your binding. (2 Min Cooldown)

-249344.name: Light Company Guidon
-249344.description: Equip: You are a volunteer of the Vanguard of the Light. Use: Lead the charge to gain 74 Haste for 15 sec. All Vanguard of the Light volunteers within 40 yards also gain 18 Speed for 6 sec. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

-249346.name: Vaelgor's Final Stare
-249346.description: Use: Seize the eye's draconic power, granting you 133 Mastery diminishing over 15 sec and allowing you to see hidden enemies. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

-250144.name: Emberwing Feather
-250144.description: Use: Unleash an Emberwing Heatwave, increasing your Haste by 68 for 15 sec. You have a low chance to suffer an Emberwing Burn, reducing one of your other secondary stats by 21 for 10 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

-250215.name: Freightrunner's Flask
-250215.description: Use: Take a sip of the drink you swiped from the freight, increasing your Critical Strike by 48 for 15 sec. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

-250225.name: Void Execution Mandate
-250225.description: Use: Mark your target for execution, increasing your Haste by 24 for 20 sec. While the target is marked, each of your attacks against them grants an additional 1 Critical Strike, as the Void urges you to finish the kill, up to a maximum of 26 Critical Strike. (2 Min Cooldown)

-250238.name: Seed of the Devouring Wild
-250238.description: Use: Awaken the Bloodthorn Roots, erupting around your target and inflicting 492 Nature damage split among nearby enemies. You absorb their essence, gaining 28 Mastery for 10 sec. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

-270168.name: Font of Venomous Rage
-270168.description: Use: Channel a torrent of venomous rage over 2 sec, dealing 306,137 Nature damage to your target and splattering all nearby enemies for 53,875 Nature damage. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets. (4 Min Cooldown)

-270169.name: Hex Lord's Dooming Idol
-270169.description: Equip: Your spells afflict you with Hex Lord's Doom, draining your Intellect by 1 up to 30 times. This effect may occur once every 6 sec. Use: Consume the power of Hex Lord's Doom, increasing your Intellect by 12 per stack for 30 sec. (30 Sec Cooldown)

-270175.name: Voracious Heart of Ula'tek
-270175.description: Use: Bite the heart and embrace the ravening hunger, gaining 149 Strength or Agility for 20 sec. While the hunger persists, gain a very high chance to devour a morsel of your target with every attack, dealing 3,525 Physical damage and further increasing your Strength or Agility by 16. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

-270602.name: Venomous Gladiator's Badge of Ferocity
-270602.description: Use: Increases primary stat by 339 for 15 sec. (1 Min Cooldown)

-273649.name: Stormbound Emblem of Dazar
-273649.description: Use: Channel for 2 sec as the wind answers Dazar's command, increasing your Haste by 128 up to 20 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

-273796.name: Vile Vial of Volatile Venom
-273796.description: Use: Take a small sip of venom, gaining 513 of a random secondary stat for 15 sec. Afterwards, a random secondary stat is reduced by 73 for 15 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

-273797.name: Tattered Amani War Banner
-273797.description: Use: Plant the banner for 15 sec! Fighting within 12 yards of it fills you with Battle Fervor, granting 305 of your highest secondary stat. Defeating at least 1 enemy while the banner stands will extend Banner's duration by 5 sec. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

-280376.name: Shadow Shard Sliver
-280376.description: Use: Raise the crystal, granting you 760 Haste for 12 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)
